name: DALYREJS.jcl
description:
This JCL job defines a Generation Data Group (GDG) named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DALYREJS to manage daily rejection records in the CardDemo application. The GDG is configured to retain a maximum of 5 generations, with older generations automatically scratched (deleted) when the limit is exceeded.Key Functionalities:
Defines a new Generation Data Group (GDG) catalog entry named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DALYREJS to organize and track daily rejection data for the CardDemo system.
Sets a generation limit of 5, meaning only the 5 most recent versions of the daily rejection data will be retained at any given time.
Enables the SCRATCH option, ensuring that when the generation limit of 5 is reached, the oldest generation is automatically deleted from the system to make room for new data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CardDemo application requires a versioned storage structure to store and manage Daily Rejection records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The GDG definition step is executed for the first time
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A Generation Data Group named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DALYREJS is successfully registered in the system catalog, making it available for all subsequent Daily Rejection data processing jobs to write and read rejection records

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05 - IDCAMS - Define Daily Rejections Generation Data Group
rules.Rule_Description: Registers a versioned storage structure in the system catalog specifically dedicated to holding CardDemo Daily Rejection records, enabling the application to manage multiple versions of rejection data over time.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Daily Rejections GDG (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DALYREJS) has been defined in the system catalog
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A new version of Daily Rejection data is created and added to the GDG
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system enforces a maximum of 5 simultaneous versions of Daily Rejection data; if the count would exceed 5, the oldest version is automatically removed to accommodate the new version

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05 - IDCAMS - Enforce Maximum of 5 Daily Rejection Versions
rules.Rule_Description: Enforces a retention policy that limits the number of coexisting Daily Rejection data versions to 5, ensuring controlled storage usage for the CardDemo application.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Daily Rejections GDG (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DALYREJS) already holds the maximum of 5 versions of Daily Rejection data
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A new (6th) version of Daily Rejection data is written to the GDG
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The oldest (1st) version of Daily Rejection data is automatically and permanently deleted from storage — it is not archived or simply uncataloged, but fully and irreversibly removed

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05 - IDCAMS - Permanently Delete Oldest Daily Rejection Version Upon Overflow
rules.Rule_Description: When the Daily Rejection version count reaches its maximum limit of 5 and a new version is added, the oldest version is automatically and permanently removed from storage with no possibility of recovery.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CardDemo application is being set up and no Daily Rejections GDG base exists in the system catalog
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The GDG definition step (STEP05) is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The versioned storage structure for Daily Rejections is established in the catalog, and all downstream Daily Rejection processing jobs are enabled to create, read, and manage Daily Rejection data versions; if this step is skipped, all downstream rejection jobs will fail

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05 - IDCAMS - Establish Daily Rejections Storage as a Prerequisite
rules.Rule_Description: The Daily Rejections GDG base must be defined in the system catalog before any Daily Rejection data can be stored or processed by the CardDemo application. This is a mandatory one-time setup step.
